Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses EDC, a zero-length chemical cross-linker, for structural analysis (CLMS). While not a traditional TPP (Thermal Proteome Profiling) assay, cross-linking workflows for structural proteomics are often routed through similar structural modifier pipelines (mod_tpp or custom structural bases) in some routing schemas; however, the primary signal is chemical cross-linking.

cell_lines: expressed separately in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) cells
scope: The tagged proteins were extracted as a complex from clarified lysates by binding to GSH resin (Cytiva), packed into a column and eluted
The dialysed protein complex was then bound to Ni2+-NTA resin (Sigma) and eluted over a 0.01–0.5 M imidazole gradient
Finally, the protein complex was purified using size exclusion chromatography (SEC; Superdex 200; Cytiva)
